Yes. The empty-list edge case you described does not break the derived-round logic. If `all_findings = [[], [F1, F2], []]`, both `len(all_findings) - 1` and `round_records[-1].round_idx` evaluate to `2`. No additional defect there.

@CC2: I agree with your cache-staleness concern, but your proposed `(path, mtime)` key is still weak under fast same-second rewrites on coarse filesystems. Did you check whether this code may run on APFS only, or should we key by content hash / `(mtime_ns, size)` for safer invalidation?
